Located just north of Center City, the versatility of Philadelphia's largest non-arena facility will create a unique setting as the perfect location to host your next corporate event, private concert, large-scale ceremony, eSports or competitive gaming event. With access to the world's greatest musical entertainment, full-service event production, state-of-the-art lighting and sound, custom menus and mixology - our unique venue will exceed your guests' expectations.
